objs.name: document
objs.description: A document in the Policies & Guidelines Management system for which levels (Policy, Guidelines, Procedural Instructions, Work Instructions) apply and which can be linked to master data and other documents.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: A new information object attached to a document to create or augment documents; attachments of new information objects during document creation.

objs.name: additionalinfo
objs.description: Additional information that can be added to a document and released directly without affecting the main document's release cycle.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Attachments that are controlled documents and are subject to their own versioning but are released with the main document and archived with it.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changes to a document, created by users with author rights and managed within the Change proposals cockpit.

objs.name: user
objs.description: People participating in workflows (authors, co-authors, readers, reviewers, releasers, translators) and groups used for authorizations.

evts.name: attach_information_object_to_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new Information Object to a Document by a user.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Content editing of the document using a local Office component and templates.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Document is saved and automatically converted to PDF; the current version is displayed.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Document release process consisting of Creator, Review, Release steps.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: All workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to readers.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content of the system into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Translation is checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approval process for translation with checking and releasing the translation.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Distribution by email informs assigned users and user groups.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Distribution for acknowledgement via email, requiring acknowledgement.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of Change Proposals for documents.

evts.name: apply_change_proposal
evts.description: Applying a Change Proposal creates a new version of the document.

evts.name: extend_validity_by_releasers
evts.description: Check and extend validity performed by releasers.

evts.name: extend_validity_by_all_release_participants
evts.description: Check and extend validity performed by authors, reviewers and releasers.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: AKS process to declare a document out of force or invalid.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: AKS check leading to invalidation and archiving of a document.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archiving of a document during AKS or validity extension processes.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Process for reactivating previously invalidated documents and their attachments.
